tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Confirm skid identity and maintenance scope
tasks.record_required: Record asset tag and date; confirm all component groups listed for this skid.
tasks.acceptance: Correct skid and scope; report missing or duplicate tags.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Review controller and device health indicators without changing operating mode
tasks.record_required: Record RUN/FAULT/COMM status and visible alarm references; do not force I/O or reset faults.
tasks.acceptance: No unexplained faults; capture and escalate any fault rather than clearing it.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect accessible exterior wiring and connectors
tasks.record_required: Record damaged insulation; loose external connectors; strain relief and label condition.
tasks.acceptance: No visible damage or missing labels; no energized enclosure access or terminal tightening.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect ventilation and cabinet condition
tasks.record_required: Record blocked vents; fan indications; dust; moisture; odor and visible discoloration.
tasks.acceptance: No obstruction or deterioration; de-energized cleaning only under an approved procedure.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Review network and operator-interface symptoms
tasks.record_required: Record link alarms; communication interruptions and reported operator issues.
tasks.acceptance: No unexplained communication loss; do not disconnect cables to test.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect visible guarding and E-stop hardware condition
tasks.record_required: Record guard/interlock/E-stop/light-curtain condition where installed; use N/A with a reason otherwise.
tasks.acceptance: No visible damage or bypass indication; functional safety testing is a separate approved procedure.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Record findings and follow-up work
tasks.record_required: Record PASS/FAIL/N/A per task; photos; defect references and technician identity.
tasks.acceptance: Every exception has a follow-up reference; do not claim safety certification.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect operator stations and motor-control hardware
tasks.record_required: Record visible button/indicator damage and starter/protection condition.
tasks.acceptance: Physical condition acceptable; no actuation or reset without approved demonstration procedure.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect firewall and switch installation
tasks.record_required: Record power/link indicators; cabling and mounting condition.
tasks.acceptance: No unexplained indication; do not change security policy.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Monthly Controls Inspection
tasks.action: Inspect terminal-bank identification
tasks.record_required: Record labels and visible terminal assembly condition from safe access.
tasks.acceptance: Labels present; no live torque check.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Reconcile installed device identity against the asset register
tasks.record_required: For each actual device record manufacturer; exact catalog/model; serial; hardware series/revision; position and source.
tasks.acceptance: Label evidence supports each value; candidate BOM families remain unverified until confirmed.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Record controller and electronic hardware firmware versions
tasks.record_required: For every firmware-bearing device record exact revision including minor/build; read method; date and evidence; N/A reason for passive devices.
tasks.acceptance: Current versions recorded per physical device; compare with approved baseline or mark baseline missing. No upgrade is authorized.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Record per-interface network configuration
tasks.record_required: Record actual IPv4; subnet mask; gateway; MAC; DHCP/static mode and device interface. Do not copy proposed addresses.
tasks.acceptance: Each address is observed with evidence; unknown stays unknown; dual ports sharing one IP are not separate devices.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Compare observed network configuration with approved design
tasks.record_required: Compare subnet; gateway; VLAN/NAT role where available; note conflicts with provisional skid plan separately.
tasks.acceptance: Only an approved as-built baseline establishes compliance; no routing/VLAN/IP changes or active scan.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Review switch port diagnostics and interface health
tasks.record_required: Record connected device and port; link speed/duplex; error counters and capture time; map only traceable connections.
tasks.acceptance: Unexpected errors or topology differences documented; a counter needs context and an approved threshold.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit
tasks.action: Verify program and configuration backup evidence
tasks.record_required: Record approved backup location; timestamp; device identity and checksum/version where available for PLC/HMI/drive/switch/firewall.
tasks.acceptance: Backup is traceable to installed hardware; an actual backup/export requires the approved procedure; no download or restore.
tasks.source: Authored planning definition from canonical IAB scope and user request; not an executed inspection

tasks.group: MHT IAB S01 Quarterly Configuration Audit

tasks.acceptance: Findings reviewed by controls owner; do not label latest firmware automatically compatible or safe.
